tips.activityTab.text.defaultMessage: The Activity tab has a tab per running agent: its card, its turn and tool call, its background tasks, subagents and processes. It opens as a snapshot; Play follows it live. An agent's ⋯ menu opens it on that agent.
tips.activityTab.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.activityTab.title.defaultMessage: See what each agent is running

tips.activityWorkspace.text.defaultMessage: Activity, in the activity bar, shows every project's running agents together, their tabs grouped by project. A card in progress opens it on the agents working on that card, and a run or a lane in the Progress panel on its agents (Show in Activity).
tips.activityWorkspace.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.advancedSettings.text.defaultMessage: After a coding agent's update, Combwork no longer sees its trust question or its sign-in errors? Settings → Advanced has the text and fields Combwork looks for, and its timeouts: change one, with the default beside it, or edit advanced.json.
tips.advancedSettings.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.agentConsole.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Agent API → Let agents read the developer console gives agents a read-only tool showing their CLI's hooks and status line next to what Combwork made of each, redacted, so they can debug what Combwork sees.
tips.agentConsole.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.agentConsole.title.defaultMessage: Let agents see what their CLI sends

tips.agentHooks.text.defaultMessage: Hooks… in an agent's ⋯ menu lists the hooks its session has, yours too, and the last hooks Combwork received: what Combwork replied, and whether it applied or ignored each one and why.
tips.agentHooks.text.description: A tip. ⋯ is the button on an agent's pane header: keep it. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.agentHooks.title.defaultMessage: See why an agent's hooks went quiet
tips.agentHooks.title.description: A tip's title. Hooks are the commands a coding agent runs at its events (a session's start, a tool call, a turn's end).

tips.agentInSlot.text.defaultMessage: Beside an agent's name on its pane: in slot-b while it builds a card in a slot (click it for Branches & remotes), carried: hb2 in the slot kept for it, home: hr4 for a reviewer's retired home. The project's hover lists them in a Slot column.
tips.agentInSlot.text.description: A tip. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Combwork lends to a card or a lane; in slot-b, carried: hb2 and home: hr4 are examples of agents.place.short, as Combwork shows them. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: slot.

tips.agentLayouts.text.defaultMessage: Each agent has its own pane: choose a layout at the right of the session toolbar, and drag a pane by its header to rearrange them. File locks stop two agents editing the same file.
tips.agentLayouts.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.agentMenu.text.defaultMessage: An agent's pane header keeps to its state, its card and Stop. Compact, Hand Over, Merge…, its settings and anything that needs a look (a dot on ⋯ says so) are in its ⋯ menu, or right-click the header. {key}
tips.agentMenu.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). ⋯ is the button on an agent's pane header: keep it. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.agentMenu.title.defaultMessage: Everything else is under an agent's ⋯
tips.agentMenu.title.description: A tip's title. ⋯ is the button on an agent's pane header: keep it.

tips.agentSettings.text.defaultMessage: Click an agent's model in its footer for Agent Settings: give a reviewer a faster model while another agent codes with the strongest.
tips.agentSettings.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.agentStates.text.defaultMessage: Each agent has one of four states, told apart by shape as well as colour: a diamond waits for you, a square is stalled, a pulsing dot is working and a ring is idle. The project header counts them: "1 waiting · 2 working".
tips.agentStates.text.description: A tip. The four shapes are the marks Combwork draws for an agent's state; keep the example's wording as the header's state line translates it.

tips.agentStates.title.defaultMessage: Read your agents at a glance

tips.agentWorkflowRole.text.defaultMessage: Each agent's Role in the workflow, in Agent Settings, says whether it builds cards, reviews them, or either. Start Lane offers builders and reviewers by it.
tips.agentWorkflowRole.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: workflow role.

tips.agentWorkflowRole.title.description: A tip's title. Glossary: builder, reviewer.

tips.agentsTempFolder.text.defaultMessage: Agents write scripts and other temporary files to Windows' Temp folder as they work. Set Settings → Advanced → Agents' temp folder to a folder of your own, such as one you exclude from antivirus scans, and each agent gets a folder there instead.
tips.agentsTempFolder.text.description: A tip (HI-2496). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Agents' temp folder is an advanced setting's title).

tips.agentsTempFolder.title.defaultMessage: Keep agents' temp files out of Windows' Temp

tips.allKeysToCli.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's pane, Combwork's shortcuts take their keys. Turn on Settings → Advanced → All keys go to the CLI to send every key to the CLI instead, but the command palette's (Show All Commands), so every command is still in reach.
tips.allKeysToCli.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.allKeysToCli.title.defaultMessage: Give every key to the agent's CLI

tips.alwaysOnTop.text.defaultMessage: The pin in the title bar (or Ctrl+Alt+O) keeps the window above your other apps, so a test run or an emulator can work underneath. Each window has its own, remembered for its workspace.
tips.alwaysOnTop.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.alwaysOnTop.title.defaultMessage: Keep a Combwork window on top

tips.antigravity.text.defaultMessage: Agents can use Google’s Antigravity CLI. Provider Setup installs it; sign in once in a terminal and every workspace on this PC shares the sign-in. Each agent runs in a private profile of its own.
tips.antigravity.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.antigravity.title.defaultMessage: Run agents on the Antigravity CLI
tips.antigravity.title.description: A tip's title. Antigravity CLI is a product name.

tips.antivirus.text.defaultMessage: On Windows, Microsoft Defender scans every file builds, tests and git touch. Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning shows whether it scans your workspace and can exclude its folders, with your consent.
tips.antivirus.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.archiveNew.text.defaultMessage: The cheapest way to carry on after a long session: archive it and start clean, so nothing old is re-cached. Write a handover first so the new one knows where to pick up.
tips.archiveNew.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistant.text.defaultMessage: The panel on the right oversees the workspace: ask what the agents are doing, what things cost, or for a plan. {key}
tips.assistant.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantAgentRequests.text.defaultMessage: An agent that needs something only the Assistant or you can do on a card, such as parking a card On Hold on your answer, asks the Assistant directly instead of leaving a comment. The request wakes it, and it acts only within its Control and what you decided.
tips.assistantAgentRequests.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands (On Hold, a board column; Control, a setting): keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantBatch.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant can move or label up to {cards, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} in one step, each card still listed on its own.
tips.assistantBatch.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. {cards} is how many cards one step can change (100).

tips.assistantCompact.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant usually works with a bigger context than your agents, so its Compact button turns orange later: past {tokens, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}} by default. Settings → Assistant → Highlight Compact over changes that, or Never turns it off.
tips.assistantCompact.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. {tokens} is the default (500,000).

tips.assistantConnection.text.defaultMessage: Assistant Settings → Connection picks the setup it runs on, for this workspace: keep it on your agents' model and effort, since a lighter one makes it careless. A server account such as DeepSeek works too, with caveats the guide lists.
tips.assistantConnection.text.description: A tip (HI-2108). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. DeepSeek is a product's name.

tips.assistantConnection.title.defaultMessage: Choose what the Assistant runs on
tips.assistantConnection.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2108): the Assistant's connection (the setup of model, effort and mode it runs on).

tips.assistantControl.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Assistant → Control decides what it may do: only advise, or also add, start and brief agents and start cards when you ask.
tips.assistantControl.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantImages.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant view's Attachments shows every screenshot and file you've pasted or dropped into its conversations, by conversation. Click a conversation's name to read it again.
tips.assistantImages.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantImages.title.defaultMessage: What you've attached to the Assistant

tips.assistantJournal.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant keeps a journal in each workspace: decisions, plans and what happened, recalled a few lines at a time after a restart. Settings → Assistant → Journal chooses what it may store, or turns it off.
tips.assistantJournal.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantJournalBrowser.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant view's Journal shows what the Assistant keeps in its journal, newest first. Search it, open an entry to correct or delete it, or use Forget These… to remove everything a search finds.
tips.assistantJournalBrowser.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantLaneWatch.text.defaultMessage: Running several lanes, the Assistant waits on all of them at once and is woken only for a failed review, a blocked or stalled card, a lane ready to merge or one that ended.
tips.assistantLaneWatch.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantLaneWatch.title.defaultMessage: One watch for all the lanes

tips.assistantLanes.text.defaultMessage: When the Assistant starts an agent on its next set of cards, it gives it a new conversation in the same step (the old one stays in the Sessions tab). Short conversations cost much less: ask it to do the same for any new card.
tips.assistantLanes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantLanes.title.defaultMessage: A new conversation for each lane

tips.assistantMcp.textAdded.defaultMessage: The Assistant gets a workspace MCP server only once you add it for it, as for a project: + in MCP Servers in its view on the activity bar, or tick Assistant in Add to… in the MCP view. A server with your own notes can reach it and no project.
tips.assistantMcp.textAdded.description: A tip (HI-1472, HI-2059). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Combwork Assistant is a box to tick; + is a button).

tips.assistantMcp.title.defaultMessage: MCP servers for the Assistant only
tips.assistantMcp.title.description: A tip's title. MCP is a protocol's name: keep it.

tips.assistantMemory.text.defaultMessage: Besides its journal, the Assistant's coding agent saves notes of its own about working with you. Memory in the Assistant view on the activity bar lists them, MEMORY.md first: open one to read or correct it.
tips.assistantMemory.text.description: A tip (HI-2666). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. MEMORY.md is a file's name: keep it.

tips.assistantMemory.title.defaultMessage: See what the Assistant's coding agent remembers

tips.assistantMessages.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant can't give a waiting or working agent a new task, but it can leave it a message, such as your answer: delivered as soon as the agent can take it. Its pane shows it as unread (✉) until then; click that to cancel it.
tips.assistantMessages.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantMessages.title.defaultMessage: The Assistant can reach a busy agent

tips.assistantNoticeOpens.text.defaultMessage: A notification from the Assistant or an agent about one agent or one card opens it when you click it: the agent's pane, or the card. Older ones are in the Notifications panel, and open from there too.
tips.assistantNoticeOpens.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantNoticeOpens.title.defaultMessage: Click a notification to go to it

tips.assistantReplies.text.defaultMessage: When you answer an agent in its pane while the Assistant watches it or its card, the Assistant is told the first line, so it doesn't ask you again. Settings → General → Your name sets how it names you; Settings → Assistant turns it off.
tips.assistantReplies.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantReplies.title.defaultMessage: The Assistant hears your answers to agents

tips.assistantSettings.text.defaultMessage: Not sure which setting would help? Ask the Assistant: it explains any of them and says where it is. With Settings → Assistant → Control → Change settings on, it can make the change, which you can revert from its panel.
tips.assistantSettings.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantSettings.title.defaultMessage: Ask the Assistant about a setting

tips.assistantSide.text.defaultMessage: Windows notifications or another app covering the right of the screen? View → Move Assistant Panel to the Left puts the Assistant beside the project list.
tips.assistantSide.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantStatus.text.defaultMessage: The line under the Assistant's header says what it is doing, and which cards it waits on and until when: click one to open it. Done by the Assistant at its end lists what it did. Under Workspace, hover an agent's mark for what it's doing; click to go there.
tips.assistantStatus.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantTeam.text.defaultMessage: With three or more agents, or builders and reviewers, ask the Assistant in Coordinator mode to run your cards as lanes: it splits them by the files they touch, briefs each pair and watches every lane to the end. With one or two agents it keeps out of the way.
tips.assistantTeam.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantTemplates.text.defaultMessage: Ask the Assistant to load a template into a project, naming any agent you like: it shows what would change first, applies the template's workflow, and Undo puts the old agents back.
tips.assistantTemplates.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantTemplates.title.defaultMessage: Have the Assistant set up a team

tips.assistantToldWaiting.text.defaultMessage: While the Assistant watches the lanes, an agent showing a permission prompt or asking you something wakes it, and it tells you which agent, its card and what it asks. It never answers for you. Its watch can follow a release card outside the lanes too.
tips.assistantToldWaiting.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantToldWaiting.title.defaultMessage: The Assistant tells you when an agent needs you

tips.assistantUndo.text.defaultMessage: Done by the Assistant lists its changes by your message. Undo on a change puts it back, and Undo on a message puts back all of them; whatever you or an agent changed since is kept.
tips.assistantUndo.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: undo, changed since.

tips.assistantWaits.text.defaultMessage: Ask the Assistant to let you know when an agent finishes a build or a test run: it waits without checking in, and Combwork wakes it when the agent finishes, needs you or stops.
tips.assistantWaits.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.assistantWaits.title.defaultMessage: Have the Assistant tell you when an agent is done

tips.attachFiles.text.defaultMessage: Drop a PDF, a log or any file onto an agent's terminal: Combwork keeps a copy with the session and pastes its path. A chip shows what's attached, and says when the agent's CLI doesn't read that kind of file itself, so the agent opens it by its path.
tips.attachFiles.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.attachFiles.title.defaultMessage: Attach any file to a prompt

tips.attachmentsTabs.text.defaultMessage: The Attachments tab has Pane attachments and Card attachments. Show in Attachments, beside a card's attachments, opens Card attachments at that card; Show Session's Attachments, in an agent's ⋯ menu, opens Pane attachments at its session.
tips.attachmentsTabs.text.description: A tip (HI-1841). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.attachmentsTabs.title.defaultMessage: Jump to a card's or a session's files

tips.autoModeSetup.text.defaultMessage: In auto mode, Claude Code may offer to teach auto mode about your environment. Combwork never answers it: the agent shows Needs input, and nothing is typed into it, until you do. Settings → Advanced → Claude Code can turn the offer off.
tips.autoModeSetup.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Claude Code is a product name, and auto mode its permission mode.

tips.autoModeSetup.title.defaultMessage: Claude Code's offer waits for you
tips.autoModeSetup.title.description: A tip's title. Claude Code is a product name: keep it in English.

tips.backupRetention.text.defaultMessage: Combwork compresses its transcript backups once a session ends, and Storage shows what they hold. To let old ones go, set Settings → Sessions → Keep transcript backups: only copies of sessions the CLI still has go to the Recycle Bin.
tips.backupRetention.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.backupRetention.title.defaultMessage: Backups take less room, and can expire

tips.banners.text.defaultMessage: Each thing is told once: a pop-up while you use Combwork, a Windows notification while it is in the background, and either way it is kept under the bell, with its buttons while they apply. Settings → Notifications chooses where pop-ups go.
tips.banners.text.description: A tip. The bell is the Notifications panel's button at the bottom of the activity bar. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.banners.title.defaultMessage: Every notification is under the bell
tips.banners.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2320: the bell is the Notifications panel).

tips.board.text.defaultMessage: Cards in On Hold, Todo, Active, Review, Approved and Done, each for a project. Start… gives a card to an agent with the card as its prompt. {key}
tips.board.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.board.title.defaultMessage: Plan work on the task board

tips.boardArchive.text.defaultMessage: Tick Archived on the board for a table of archived cards: sort and filter them by project, label or the column they came from, and Unarchive one or a whole selection.
tips.boardArchive.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.boardArchiveAll.text.defaultMessage: A column's ⋯ has Archive All in Done (n)…, and the board's ⋯ has Archive All Cards… for every column. Cards agents are on are skipped unless you say, and Undo puts everything back where it was.
tips.boardArchiveAll.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.boardArchiveAll.title.defaultMessage: Clear a column in one go

tips.boardDoing.text.defaultMessage: Drag a card into Active and Combwork asks: nobody yet, an agent without starting anything, or an agent that starts on it now.
tips.boardDoing.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.boardDoing.title.defaultMessage: Choose who works on a card in Active

tips.boardDone.text.defaultMessage: A reviewer moves a card that passes its review to Approved; Done means merged, and an agent moves its cards there after merging its work. Say "merged, move #65 to done" and it does; the card's history shows who moved it.
tips.boardDone.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.boardExport.text.defaultMessage: The board is kept in the workspace's database. Export Board to JSON… in the board's ⋯ menu saves every card as a JSON file, archived ones too, in a folder you choose.
tips.boardExport.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.boardFold.text.defaultMessage: Collapse a column to a narrow strip with the « in its header, and fold cards to one line with their ▾; a column's ⋯ collapses or expands all its cards. Combwork remembers them for the workspace.
tips.boardFold.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.boardFold.title.defaultMessage: Fold the board to what matters

tips.boardHygiene.text.defaultMessage: Ask the Assistant to tidy the board: it links duplicate cards for you to archive, records your answers as decisions on their cards, and raises blocked reasons that are out of date.
tips.boardHygiene.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Decisions are what the user decided about a card, as the card shows them.

tips.boardHygiene.title.defaultMessage: Ask the Assistant to tidy the board

tips.boardOrder.text.defaultMessage: Drag the most important cards to the top, or ask the Assistant or an agent to prioritise: they reorder the board itself.
tips.boardOrder.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.boardOrder.title.defaultMessage: A column's order is its priority

tips.boardReview.text.defaultMessage: Say "review #87" to another agent: the card stays in Review with the agent that did the work, shows who is reviewing it, and gets the verdict as a comment. When it passes, the reviewer moves it to Approved.
tips.boardReview.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.boardReview.title.defaultMessage: Have an agent review a card

tips.boardSetAside.text.defaultMessage: Opened in an older Combwork, a workspace gets its cards set aside when this one opens it again. Review… on the notice, or Set-Aside Cards… in the board's ⋯ menu, adds each to the board or discards it.
tips.boardSetAside.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.boardSetAside.title.defaultMessage: Cards made by an older Combwork

tips.boardStages.text.defaultMessage: The board’s columns are the stages your workflow options make: Merging sits under Approved while Combwork merges, and a stage nobody uses is hidden. Ask the Assistant to rename one, such as “call Active Building in web”: a name changes no rule.
tips.boardStages.text.description: A tip (glossary 2.2: stage). Active is a board column: use its name as the board shows it. The quoted request is what the user would ask the Assistant: translate it.

tips.boardStages.title.defaultMessage: The board shows your workflow’s stages

tips.boardUpgrade.text.defaultMessage: Combwork keeps the 0.9 board it upgraded to 1.0. Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup… puts it back, after keeping a copy of the board as it is, so version 0.9 can change it again.
tips.boardUpgrade.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.branchCards.text.defaultMessage: In Version Control → Branches & remotes, a branch a card works on shows the card and its stage, and in Review the revision under review. Click the card to open it.
tips.branchCards.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (glossary 2.1: Version Control; 2.2: stage).

tips.branchCards.title.defaultMessage: See which card a branch is for

tips.branchCleanup.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Branches & remotes groups the branches as In use, Merged and Not merged. Clean Up Merged Branches… deletes the merged ones nothing uses, and offers the merged ones on your remotes apart, never ticked for you.
tips.branchCleanup.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.bringUpToDate.text.defaultMessage: A branch’s merge queue card says when it is behind another of the project’s branches. Bring Up to Date… merges that branch into it through its queue, with its merge checks; the other branch doesn’t change.
tips.bringUpToDate.text.description: A tip (HI-2679). Bring Up to Date… is a button on a merge queue's card: keep it as Combwork shows it.

tips.bringUpToDate.title.defaultMessage: Bring the next release up to date
tips.bringUpToDate.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2679): merging one of a project's branches into another through the merge queue.

tips.cardAttachments.text.defaultMessage: Paste or drop files into a card's description or comment: they are kept with the card when you save or post, shown in it, and listed for the agent that starts it. The pin on a pane's attachment chip copies a file to the agent's card.
tips.cardAttachments.text.description: A tip (HI-1700). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.cardAttachments.title.defaultMessage: Keep a screenshot with its card

tips.cardAttachmentsCleanup.text.defaultMessage: Files kept with a card go to the Recycle Bin 30 days after it is archived. Choose 3, 7 or 90 days, or Never, in Project Settings → Storage, where Clean Up Now… removes what is due at once. Open and Done cards keep theirs.
tips.cardAttachmentsCleanup.text.description: A tip (HI-1842). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.cardAttachmentsCleanup.title.defaultMessage: Archived cards' screenshots clean up after themselves

tips.cardAttachmentsFolders.text.defaultMessage: Agents attach files to cards from their own project and the temp folder. Keep test evidence in a folder of your own? List it in Settings → Advanced → Card attachments: more folders, and they can attach from there without copying into Temp.
tips.cardAttachmentsFolders.text.description: A tip (HI-2480). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Card attachments: more folders is an advanced setting's title).

tips.cardAttachmentsFolders.title.defaultMessage: Let agents attach your test evidence where it is

tips.cardCost.text.defaultMessage: A card's panel says what its agents used while they held it, "{example}", with the builder's and reviewer's parts and tokens on hover. Performance lists every card's cost, and a lane's hover in the Progress panel its overhead.
tips.cardCost.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. {example} is a card's cost line as the board shows it ("cost: ≈ $1.84 · 2 rounds").

tips.cardCostRounds.text.defaultMessage: A card's Work section ends with its cost by round: the builder's and reviewer's parts in each round, adding up to the card's cost. See whether extra rounds or one long read drove it.
tips.cardCostRounds.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Work is a section of the card dialog).

tips.cardDecisions.text.defaultMessage: A card's Decisions, above its comments, hold what you decided: agents check their work against them before Review, and reviewers fail work that ignores one. Tell the Assistant a decision and it records it there; an agent waiting for your answer is told.
tips.cardDecisions.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.cardDecisions.title.defaultMessage: Put what you decide on the card

tips.cardLinks.text.defaultMessage: Card numbers an agent or the Assistant prints, like #12, are links: hover one for its title and column, and Ctrl+click it to open the card.
tips.cardLinks.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.cardLinks.title.defaultMessage: Ctrl+click a card number in the terminal

tips.cardLoop.text.defaultMessage: Tell one agent to work through some cards as the builder and another to review them: each waits for the other at no cost, and Combwork wakes it when the card changes.
tips.cardLoop.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.cardLoop.title.defaultMessage: Let two agents build and review in turn

tips.cardMove.text.defaultMessage: Drag any dialog by its header (a card, Add Agent, Agent Settings…) to see what's behind it; Escape while dragging puts it back.
tips.cardMove.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.cardMove.title.defaultMessage: Move a dialog out of the way

tips.cardReadFirst.text.defaultMessage: In a card's Read first, list the doc sections it needs, like docs/PLAN.md#setup: the agent's start prompt lists them, so it reads those sections instead of a whole plan. Click one to read it in Combwork.
tips.cardReadFirst.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Keep docs/PLAN.md#setup as it is.

tips.cardReadFirst.title.defaultMessage: Point a card at the docs it needs

tips.cardSummaries.text.defaultMessage: Agents start a card's report or review verdict with one line saying what is ready or what was found, the details below; they and the Assistant read just those lines when that's enough.
tips.cardSummaries.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.cardWork.text.defaultMessage: Open a card: its Work section lists each revision submitted for review, with its round, files, verdicts and checks, and how it was merged. On the board, a card shows its revision and last verdict.
tips.cardWork.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands (Work): keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: work, revision, verdict, check.

tips.cardWork.title.defaultMessage: See what a card’s work went through
tips.cardWork.title.description: A tip's title. Glossary: work (a card's Work section).

tips.chooseConnections.text.defaultMessage: Project Settings → Agents → Choose Connections… picks a connection for each role of the project's agents (or one for all, or per agent), changing nothing else. Loading a template offers the same choice.
tips.chooseConnections.text.description: A tip (HI-2109). A connection is a named setup on an account (model, effort, mode). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.chooseConnections.title.defaultMessage: High effort for every builder, in one go
tips.chooseConnections.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2109). Glossary: builder, effort.

tips.claudeStatusLine.text.defaultMessage: Combwork's status line feeds an agent's footer and shows nothing in the pane. Turn off Settings → Advanced → Combwork's status line in place of yours to see the one in your Claude Code settings again: Combwork still reads the status.
tips.claudeStatusLine.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.claudeStatusLine.title.defaultMessage: Keep your own Claude Code status line
tips.claudeStatusLine.title.description: A tip's title. The status line is the line Claude Code shows under its input.

tips.cliOverrides.text.defaultMessage: Combwork changes a little of how each CLI behaves in its sessions, such as Copilot not updating itself or Codex's terminal title. Each change can be turned off in Settings → Advanced, under its CLI, which says what Combwork can no longer do without it.
tips.cliOverrides.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.cliOverrides.title.defaultMessage: Keep a CLI as it is outside Combwork

tips.cliOwnMode.text.defaultMessage: Choose The CLI's own setting as an agent's or a project's permission mode and Combwork passes none: the CLI starts in the mode its own config sets. The badge says CLI's own, and switching a running session restarts it.
tips.cliOwnMode.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.cliOwnMode.title.defaultMessage: Let the CLI's own config choose the mode

tips.closeCommands.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Workspace → When this workspace closes, run: Combwork runs your command once it has closed the workspace and finished writing its files, and shows it running until it ends.
tips.closeCommands.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.closeCommands.title.defaultMessage: Run a backup as a workspace closes

tips.closeWindow.text.defaultMessage: With several windows open, File → Close Window ({key}) closes just this one, as its X does. Exit Combwork (all windows) closes every window and stops all their agents.
tips.closeWindow.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.closeWindow.title.defaultMessage: Close one window, or all of them

tips.codexSandboxConnections.text.defaultMessage: Codex connections keep asking for Administrator permission? Each one's admin sandbox setup resets the others'. Settings → Advanced → Codex → Connections: use Codex's non-admin sandbox runs them all without it, at the cost of separate sandbox accounts.
tips.codexSandboxConnections.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Connections: use Codex's non-admin sandbox is an advanced setting's title). Codex is a product's name.

tips.codexSandboxConnections.title.defaultMessage: Several Codex connections, no admin prompts
tips.codexSandboxConnections.title.description: A tip's title. Codex is a product's name.

tips.codexScriptCalls.text.defaultMessage: Codex in code mode runs its tools from a script. In the Sessions tab, a Script line says how many calls it made and which; open it to read each call with its own result.
tips.codexScriptCalls.text.description: A tip (HI-2240). Codex is a product name; Script is the transcript's name for it, kept as Combwork shows it. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.codexScriptCalls.title.defaultMessage: See what a Codex script did
tips.codexScriptCalls.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2240). Codex is a product name; a script is the code Codex runs to call its tools.

tips.combworkFolder.text.defaultMessage: Combwork keeps each project's .combwork folder (sessions, backups, launch settings) out of git by itself. Where it can't, say with no git, another version control system, or a folder OneDrive or Dropbox syncs, the project's Overview tells you.
tips.combworkFolder.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.combworkFolder.title.defaultMessage: A project's .combwork stays on this computer

tips.combworkMerges.text.defaultMessage: In Version Control → Workflow, choose Pair, or set Who merges to Combwork merges: Combwork’s merge queue merges each approved card once its checks pass on the merged result, so red work never reaches the target branch.
tips.combworkMerges.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (glossary 2.1: merge queue).

tips.combworkSkills.text.defaultMessage: Agents and the Assistant get Combwork's own skills: work-on-card, review-agent-work, handover and more. Combwork keeps them up to date; ones you edit stay yours.
tips.combworkSkills.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.commandName.description: A command's name in a tip's text, where its shortcut would be when it has none. Use your language's quotation marks.

tips.compactFocus.text.defaultMessage: Compact summarises the conversation so every later message costs less. Give it a focus ("keep the API decisions, drop the test output") and the agent keeps what matters. {key}
tips.compactFocus.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.compactSidebar.text.defaultMessage: Toggle Compact Sidebar turns the project list into a narrow rail of tiles with each project's agents, leaving more room for the terminals.
tips.compactSidebar.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.compactionHistory.text.defaultMessage: The Overview's compaction history pages, filters and sorts a long session's compactions; click one to read it in the transcript, with the summary the agent carried on from.
tips.compactionHistory.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.compactionHistory.title.defaultMessage: Read a compaction where it happened

tips.compareBranches.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Changes compares any two local branches without checking anything out: pick one under Branches to see the commits each has that the other hasn't, the files it changes, and each file's diff.
tips.compareBranches.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.compareBranches.title.defaultMessage: Compare two branches, such as 1.0.0 with main

tips.conflictHunks.text.defaultMessage: When the merge queue sends a card back for a conflict, its Work section lists the files: click one to see its conflicts, the target's side and the card's under their names, as the queue's test merge had them.
tips.conflictHunks.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.connectionOrder.text.defaultMessage: Drag accounts into your order in Settings → Accounts & Connections: a new agent gets the first connection of the first account that's on in the workspace. Running agents keep theirs.
tips.connectionOrder.text.description: A tip (HI-2107). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.connectionOrder.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2107): the one order of accounts, for every coding agent CLI.

tips.connectionSetups.text.defaultMessage: Add Connection under an account in Settings → Accounts & Connections makes another setup on the same sign-in, say "Claude · High" beside "Claude · Medium". Agents choose a connection, so one edit changes every agent on it.
tips.connectionSetups.text.description: A tip (HI-2107). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Add Connection is a button). "Claude · High" and "Claude · Medium" are example names of connections.

tips.connectionSetups.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2107): connections, several on one account.

tips.connectionTags.text.defaultMessage: Give connections on both accounts the same tag, such as Builders or Assistant (the Tag box in a connection's dialog): when a usage move sends agents to the other account, each goes to the connection with its tag, and the Assistant moves too.
tips.connectionTags.text.description: A tip (HI-2530). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Builders and Assistant are example tags.

tips.connectionTags.title.defaultMessage: Tag connections so moved agents keep their kind
tips.connectionTags.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2530): a connection's tag (a free-text label, such as Builders) lets a usage move put each agent on the same kind of connection on the other account.

tips.connectionTrust.text.defaultMessage: A new connection's Set Up asks Claude Code once, in the workspace folder, to trust every project in it. Codex agents never ask: each trusts its own folder for that launch (Settings → Advanced → Codex).
tips.connectionTrust.text.description: A tip (HI-1871): how a new connection's coding agent CLIs come to trust the workspace's folders. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Set Up is a button).

tips.connectionTrust.title.defaultMessage: Trust a workspace in one answer

tips.connections.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Accounts & Connections keeps several Claude Code and Codex sign-ins, or a server such as Ollama on this PC. Each workspace chooses which accounts are on, and each agent runs on the connection it chose: pick another in Agent Settings.
tips.connections.text.description: A tip (HI-2107). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Ollama is a product's name.

tips.consoleRecording.text.defaultMessage: In the developer console, Record writes what an agent's CLI sends Combwork to a file, redacted unless you tick text for that recording, and Copy Diagnostics can attach it to a bug report.
tips.consoleRecording.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.consoleText.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Advanced → Developer console: show prompt, reply and command text shows them in the developer console, under a banner saying so, and ticks text for new recordings. Tokens and sign-ins stay masked, and agents' cw_console stays redacted.
tips.consoleText.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.consoleText.title.defaultMessage: See the text in the developer console

tips.copilot.text.defaultMessage: Agents can use the GitHub Copilot CLI, Copilot Free included. Provider Setup installs it and says who it is signed in as: its own login or the GitHub CLI’s.
tips.copilot.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.copilotModes.text.defaultMessage: Copilot agents start in Accept edits: they edit files in their own folder and use the Combwork tools without asking, and ask before other commands, other MCP tools and web access. Choose Ask to approve each edit too, or Allow all to approve everything.
tips.copilotModes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.copyDiagnostics.text.defaultMessage: Help → Copy Diagnostics… gathers Combwork's version, your coding agents, key settings and the end of the log for a bug report, with names, folders and tokens taken out.
tips.copyDiagnostics.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.ctrlCvToCli.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's pane Ctrl+C copies a selection and Ctrl+V pastes. Turn on Settings → Advanced → Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V go to the CLI to send both keys to the CLI instead, as in any other terminal; right-click still copies and pastes.
tips.ctrlCvToCli.text.description: A tip. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V name keys: use the key names your language uses. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.ctrlCvToCli.title.defaultMessage: Give Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V to the agent's CLI
tips.ctrlCvToCli.title.description: A tip's title. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V name keys: use the key names your language uses.

tips.customCommands.text.defaultMessage: Name a command once in Settings → Commands and run it from the command palette (Run Command), or pick it for when a workspace opens or closes: a local server or a database your agents need, say. As a workspace opens, its agents start once they are done.
tips.customCommands.text.description: A tip (HI-1954). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands (Settings → Commands, Run Command): keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.customCommands.title.defaultMessage: Your own commands, one click away

tips.dateFormat.text.defaultMessage: Combwork shows dates as {date} and times as {time}. Settings → General → Date format and Time format change them everywhere, sessions named by when they started too.
tips.dateFormat.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. {date} and {time} are an example date and time (4 October 2026, 14:05) in the formats chosen now.

tips.designCheck.text.defaultMessage: Ask a card loop’s builder for a design first: it posts it on the card, Combwork wakes the reviewer to check it, and the answer wakes the builder. With no answer within the Design check wait (Version Control → Workflow → Card loops), it goes ahead as posted.
tips.designCheck.text.description: A tip (#1382). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Design check wait, Version Control, Workflow, Card loops).

tips.designCheck.title.defaultMessage: Have a design checked before the build
tips.designCheck.title.description: A tip's title (#1382). A design: the plan a builder posts on its card before building.

tips.developerConsole.text.defaultMessage: Turn on Settings → Advanced → Show developer features, then Help → Developer Console opens a window of its own: pick an agent and see each hook and status line beside what Combwork made of it, redacted. Filter, search and pause as it runs.
tips.developerConsole.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.developerConsole.title.defaultMessage: Watch what a CLI sends Combwork

tips.dialects.text.defaultMessage: The Dialects view shows every text Combwork gives agents, and lets a model, a CLI or the workspace word some of them its own way. Duplicate a file to try a change on one agent (Agent Settings → Dialect); it applies at the agent's next launch.
tips.dialects.text.description: A tip (HI-2444). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: dialect.

tips.dialects.title.defaultMessage: Tune the words Combwork gives agents

tips.dialectsNewModel.text.defaultMessage: In the Dialects view, New Model File on a CLI's group starts a file for a model, even one no agent runs yet: type its ID. Duplicate can name the copy's model too, and Set Model gives one of your files to a model. It applies at each agent's next launch.
tips.dialectsNewModel.text.description: A tip (HI-2523). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: dialect.

tips.dialectsNewModel.title.defaultMessage: A dialect file for any model

tips.editTemplates.text.defaultMessage: Select a template in the Templates view and choose Edit…: add, copy, reorder or remove its agents, change each in the Agent Settings dialog (its Save saves the template too), rename it and pick its layout.
tips.editTemplates.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.fileLinks.text.defaultMessage: File paths an agent prints, like src/app.ts:42, are links: Ctrl+click one to open the file in the Files tab at that line.
tips.fileLinks.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.fileLinks.title.defaultMessage: Ctrl+click a path in the terminal

tips.filesTab.text.defaultMessage: The Files tab browses and edits the project, previews Markdown, CSV, HTML and images, and keeps unsaved edits as you switch.
tips.filesTab.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.flightRecorder.text.defaultMessage: Turn on a flight recorder trigger in Settings → Advanced (safeguard stops, something unknown from a CLI, a CLI version change, an agent gone silent), and Combwork saves the agent's recent developer console events, redacted, when it happens, with a notice.
tips.flightRecorder.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.focusedTests.text.defaultMessage: With Combwork merging, Version Control → Workflow can run each card’s focused tests on the merged result: your project’s command chooses the tests a change needs when the card is submitted, and the merge queue runs them before it merges.
tips.focusedTests.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: merge queue.

tips.focusedTests.title.defaultMessage: Each card’s own tests before it merges
tips.focusedTests.title.description: A tip's title: the workflow option that has Combwork's merge queue run the tests a card's change needs on the merged result (G20).

tips.followUpCheck.text.defaultMessage: When you ask for a change to a card in Review or Approved for its reviewer to check, its builder posts the change as a follow-up: Combwork wakes the reviewer, and the answer wakes the builder. One left unanswered for 15 minutes shows its card as stalled.
tips.followUpCheck.text.description: A tip (#1467). Review and Approved are board columns. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.followUpCheck.title.defaultMessage: Have a follow-up checked without a new round
tips.followUpCheck.title.description: A tip's title (#1467). A follow-up: a change asked of a card's reviewed work, such as a screenshot's, for its reviewer to check.

tips.forYou.text.defaultMessage: A card with a For you chip waits for you: an approval, a decision or a question. The Task Board icon counts them, and For you on the board shows only those. Open the card to approve, decline or answer: the agent waiting on it hears at once.
tips.forYou.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: For you, approve.

tips.forYouActions.text.defaultMessage: When an agent's question is about something only you can do on its card, it can offer it as a button under the question: Move to Done, Make It No Code or Unblock, with its suggested reason, which you can change. One click does it and answers the agent.
tips.forYouActions.text.description: A tip (#1630). Done is a board column. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: For you, no-code card.

tips.forYouApproveNote.text.defaultMessage: Approve takes an optional note. On an agent's question it's recorded as your decision on the card, so the agent works to it and its reviewer checks it; on Combwork's own requests it's your comment. Left empty, Approve is one click.
tips.forYouApproveNote.text.description: A tip (HI-2286). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: approve, decision, For you.

tips.forYouApproveNote.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2286): approving a request while asking for a change.

tips.generalistRole.text.defaultMessage: Give an agent the Generalist role in the workflow (Agent Settings) and it does whatever you ask in its pane: it is never put in a lane or asked to review. A card it takes still follows the project’s workflow.
tips.generalistRole.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Generalist is a role's name (Glossary: generalist).

tips.generalistRole.title.defaultMessage: An agent for whatever you ask

tips.gitCheck.text.defaultMessage: Help → Provider Setup… shows the git Combwork found and its version. Worktree agents, merging and the Version Control tab’s Git sections need Git for Windows 2.38 or later.
tips.gitCheck.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.gitHistory.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → History opens on the branch your work merges into. Pick another in its heading, yours or a remote’s, and page back through older commits under the list.
tips.gitHistory.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.gitHistory.title.defaultMessage: See the history of any branch

tips.gitInit.text.defaultMessage: A project without git? Its Version Control tab's Initialise repository… makes it one on main, keeps .combwork out, adds a starter .gitignore if you like and makes the first commit, so agents can work in worktrees at once.
tips.gitInit.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.gitInit.title.defaultMessage: Make a project a git repository in one click

tips.gitRemotes.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Branches & remotes: Push to… sends this branch, or every branch and tag, to any remote without changing what the branch tracks. A remote can be renamed or removed there, and a branch's Track… chooses what Pull and Push use.
tips.gitRemotes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.gitView.text.defaultMessage: In a Git project, the Version Control tab shows its branch, remotes, history and tags, and lets you switch or create a branch, fetch, pull, push, tag and set its commit identity. The status bar shows "{example}": click it to get there.
tips.gitView.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. {example} is the status bar's git item as Combwork shows it ("main · origin · ↑2 ↓0": the branch, its remote, and how many commits it is ahead and behind).

tips.gitView.title.defaultMessage: See and change a project's git

tips.gotoProject.text.defaultMessage: Press {key} and type a few letters of its name.
tips.gotoProject.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.group.agents.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about agents.

tips.group.assistant.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about the Combwork Assistant.

tips.group.board.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about the task board.

tips.group.files.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about files and a project's git.

tips.group.sessions.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about sessions.

tips.group.shortcuts.description: A heading of Help → Tips: shortcuts and other ways to get around Combwork.

tips.handoverSelf.text.defaultMessage: When an agent's transcript size turns amber, click it and choose the agent itself: it writes a handover, and a new conversation picks up from it, short and fast again.
tips.handoverSelf.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.handoverSelf.title.defaultMessage: A long conversation? Hand it over to itself

tips.hardwareAcceleration.text.defaultMessage: If your graphics driver leaves Combwork's window blank, flickering or crashing, turn on Settings → Advanced → Disable hardware acceleration and restart Combwork. A window that doesn't draw at all: start Combwork once with --disable-gpu.
tips.hardwareAcceleration.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. --disable-gpu is a command-line option: keep it.

tips.hooksMissing.text.defaultMessage: If a CLI update or a policy stops an agent’s hooks reaching Combwork, its pane says Status unknown instead of a status that may be wrong, nothing is typed into it and its lane pauses. The banner over its pane says why when Combwork can tell.
tips.hooksMissing.text.description: A tip. Hooks: the calls an agent's coding agent makes to Combwork as it works. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.hooksMissing.title.defaultMessage: When an agent’s hooks stop arriving
tips.hooksMissing.title.description: A tip's title. Hooks: the calls an agent's coding agent makes to Combwork as it works.

tips.howDoYouWork.text.defaultMessage: A new project’s Version Control tab asks “How do you work?”: Solo, Pair or Team, the one that fits its agents suggested. Choose sets it up in one click; Not Now keeps your defaults.
tips.howDoYouWork.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (glossary 2.1: Version Control, preset). The quoted question is the step's heading: use it as Combwork shows it.

tips.howDoYouWork.title.defaultMessage: Start a new project with a preset

tips.imagesTab.text.defaultMessage: The Attachments tab keeps each screenshot and file pasted or dropped into the project's sessions, grouped by session, with previews and a filter by kind, ready to insert again.
tips.imagesTab.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.imagesTab.title.defaultMessage: Everything you attached, in one place

tips.improveTranslation.text.defaultMessage: Spotted a clumsy or wrong word in your language? Help → Improve This Translation shows how to fix it, or add a language, with a pull request on GitHub.
tips.improveTranslation.text.description: A tip. Help → Improve This Translation is a name in Combwork: keep it as Combwork shows it. GitHub is a name.

tips.improveTranslation.title.defaultMessage: Make Combwork read better in your language

tips.inboxCarryingOn.text.defaultMessage: Combwork tells a working agent of new messages at a tool's end, keeps it going to read them before it stops, and wakes it when idle. Each has a switch in Settings → Advanced, and a project can set its own; with wakes off, the pane's Deliver Now types the line.
tips.inboxCarryingOn.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.inboxCarryingOn.title.defaultMessage: Choose how agents hear of their inbox

tips.inboxNotices.text.defaultMessage: A message the Assistant leaves a working agent reaches it at its next tool call, or before its turn ends, as a short notice from Combwork: nothing is typed over its work. The agent reads and acks it in its inbox; its pane shows it as unread (✉) until it does.
tips.inboxNotices.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.inboxNotices.title.defaultMessage: Messages reach a busy agent between steps

tips.isolatedChecks.text.defaultMessage: In a shared folder, another agent's edit during a check makes it not count. cw-progress --check typecheck --isolated runs it in a copy of its own at the card's revision, which nothing else writes. Stop in the Progress panel ends it and all it started.
tips.isolatedChecks.text.description: A tip. cw-progress --check typecheck --isolated is a command: keep it as it is. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.isolatedChecks.title.defaultMessage: A check nobody else can spoil

tips.keepAwake.text.defaultMessage: While an agent works, Combwork stops Windows from sleeping (the screen can still lock), and lets it sleep once they're done. Choose when in Settings → General.
tips.keepAwake.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.keepAwake.title.defaultMessage: Leave agents working, the PC stays awake

tips.laneApplyNow.text.defaultMessage: In Start Lane for a lane's builder, Apply now changes the order at once: the card being worked goes back to Todo with its work kept on its branch, and the builder is told.
tips.laneApplyNow.text.description: A tip (HI-1995). Start Lane and Apply now are a dialog and its checkbox; Todo is a board column. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.laneApplyNow.title.description: A tip's title (HI-1995). A lane is Combwork's record of a card loop (a builder and a reviewer taking cards in turn).

tips.laneBranchSquash.text.defaultMessage: After an agent's card is squash-merged, Combwork brings its branch up to date before its next card, so each review shows only that card's work. What it can't do safely it asks under For you; Settings → Advanced makes it ask every time.
tips.laneBranchSquash.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. For you is the board's list of what waits for the user.

tips.laneBranchSquash.title.defaultMessage: An agent's branch kept up to date between cards
tips.laneBranchSquash.title.description: A tip's title. The branch is the one an agent builds on in its own worktree.

tips.laneGates.text.defaultMessage: In the Progress panel, a lane says why it waits in its header, and a red notch on a card’s segment means its last request was refused: hover it for why and what next.
tips.laneGates.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: lane, refused.

tips.laneGates.title.defaultMessage: See why a lane isn’t moving
tips.laneGates.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Combwork's record of a card loop (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.laneNext.text.defaultMessage: With workflow rules on, once a lane's card is Done Combwork gives the next one to its builder as soon as the builder's turn is over, so the lane goes on without a prompt from you or the Assistant.
tips.laneNext.text.description: A tip (HI-1990). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.laneNext.title.defaultMessage: Combwork starts a lane's next card
tips.laneNext.title.description: A tip's title (HI-1990). A lane is Combwork's record of a card loop (a builder and a reviewer taking cards in turn).

tips.laneNotices.text.defaultMessage: Combwork notifies you when a lane's review fails, a card is blocked or stalls, or every card has passed so its merge is due, one notice per lane. Settings → Notifications decides where they appear.
tips.laneNotices.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.laneNotices.title.defaultMessage: Hear how a lane goes, without the Assistant
tips.laneNotices.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Combwork's record of a card loop (a builder and a reviewer taking cards in turn).

tips.laneSlots.text.defaultMessage: In the Progress panel, a lane names its slot after its agents (· slot-b): point at it for the branch being built there and whether the slot is ready, or click it for Branches & remotes.
tips.laneSlots.text.description: A tip. A slot is a working folder Combwork lends to a lane (glossary 2.5: slot). Branches & remotes is a section of the Version Control tab: keep its name as Combwork shows it.

tips.laneSlots.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Combwork's record of a card loop (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.laneStart.text.defaultMessage: Right-click the Todo column and choose Start Lane with These Cards…: pick the builder and the reviewer, put the cards in order, and both start with a brief. End or abandon a lane from its row in the Progress panel.
tips.laneStart.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: lane.

tips.laneStart.title.description: A tip's title. A lane: a builder and a reviewer agent working through cards in turn (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.lanesLegend.text.defaultMessage: Hover over the Lanes bar in the Progress panel for its legend: each colour is a category, with the stages in it. A lane marked old rules keeps the workflow options it started with until it ends.
tips.lanesLegend.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: lane, stage, category, workflow options.

tips.lanesLegend.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Combwork's record of a card loop (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.language.text.defaultMessage: Combwork follows Windows' display language when it has it. Settings → General → Language picks another; languages translated by AI are marked, and improvements are welcome. Agents are still spoken to in English.
tips.language.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.launchSettings.text.defaultMessage: A connection's ⋯ → Launch Settings… → Launch as from a terminal starts its agents with none of Combwork's guidance, tools or typing, as if you had opened the CLI in that folder yourself. They are Independent: in the team, but out of the workflow.
tips.launchSettings.text.description: A tip (HI-2670). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Launch Settings… is a menu entry, Launch as from a terminal a switch). Glossary: independent.

tips.launchSettings.title.defaultMessage: An agent as if from a terminal
tips.launchSettings.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2670): a connection whose sessions start with none of Combwork's additions.

tips.leftRunning.text.defaultMessage: A process an agent's command started that keeps running after its shell has gone shows in Activity as Left running, with its CPU time and End It. Past ten minutes, a notice says so once, and the agent is told too.
tips.leftRunning.text.description: A tip (HI-2111). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Left running is a row's label; End It a button).

tips.leftRunning.title.defaultMessage: Spot what a command left running

tips.leftoverBranches.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Changes lists leftover branches: a superseded or archived card’s, an agent’s from before slots. Compare one with your target first, then Delete… it; one with commits of its own lists them before it goes.
tips.leftoverBranches.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.leftoverProcesses.text.defaultMessage: A preview server or a tail -f an agent started can keep running after it stops, holding the project's folder or a port. Combwork lists them in the ⋯ menu on the agent's pane and offers to end them; Settings → Agents can end them every time.
tips.leftoverProcesses.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.leftoverProcesses.title.defaultMessage: End what a stopped agent left running

tips.licenceAudit.text.defaultMessage: Before a release, ask an agent to audit the licences of what your project ships. It reads them from the files, vendored material and installer parts included, and flags anything unclear for you.
tips.licenceAudit.text.description: A tip. Vendored material is other people's files a package carries inside it; installer parts are what the installer adds (its plug-ins and helpers).

tips.licenceAudit.title.defaultMessage: Audit the licences of what you ship

tips.localModelLimits.text.defaultMessage: On a server account’s models (Settings → Accounts & Connections, Edit Server…), set Context size and Output budget: agents started on that model then compact at its real context rather than an assumed 200,000.
tips.localModelLimits.text.description: A tip (HI-2682). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and fields: keep them as Combwork shows them (Edit Server… is a button).

tips.localModelLimits.title.defaultMessage: Tell Claude Code your local model’s real context
tips.localModelLimits.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2682): a local model on a server account, its context size.

tips.localModelPicker.text.defaultMessage: An agent on a server account finds the account’s models in Claude Code’s /model, by their exact IDs. Give each a Label in Edit Server… to name it there.
tips.localModelPicker.text.description: A tip (HI-2684). /model is a Claude Code command: keep it. Label is a field of a server account's models and Edit Server… a button: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.localModelPicker.title.defaultMessage: Switch local models in Claude Code’s /model
tips.localModelPicker.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2684): a server account's models in Claude Code's model picker. /model is a command: keep it.

tips.loopDefaults.text.defaultMessage: Rounds and Wait under Card loops in Settings → Version Control set what loops use when you don't say ({rounds, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}} and {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} to start with); a workspace and a project can set their own. Saying "rounds: 3" when you start one still wins.
tips.loopDefaults.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. {rounds} and {hours} are the defaults (10 and 6). "rounds: 3" is what the user types to an agent: keep it in English.

tips.loopDefaults.title.defaultMessage: Your rounds and wait for every loop

tips.loopLanes.text.defaultMessage: When two agents build and review cards in turn, Combwork keeps the loop as a lane: its cards in order, the one it's on, and whether it's paused on a blocked card. Ask the Assistant which lanes are running.
tips.loopLanes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.loopLanes.title.defaultMessage: Combwork keeps your card loops as lanes

tips.loopWakes.text.defaultMessage: When a card arrives in Review, Combwork wakes its reviewer, and on the verdict its builder, even if one forgot to wait. To drive reviews by hand, turn off Wake reviewers and builders in the project's Version Control → Workflow → Card loops.
tips.loopWakes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.loopWakes.title.defaultMessage: Loops keep going on their own

tips.mainProcessStalls.text.defaultMessage: Typing lagged a moment? Performance → Main process stalls lists the times Combwork's main process was busy since it started: how long, whether it was working or waiting, and what was under way.
tips.mainProcessStalls.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Main process stalls is a section of the Performance view).

tips.maxAgents.text.defaultMessage: Maximum agents in Version Control → Workflow is how many agents a project has, so nobody brings in agents you didn’t plan for, the Assistant included. Each preset sets its team: Solo one agent, Pair a builder and a reviewer. Raise it there to add more.
tips.maxAgents.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Maximum agents is a workflow option (HI-2001); Solo and Pair are presets.

tips.maxAgents.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2001): the workflow option Maximum agents, how many agents a project has.

tips.mcpCatalogue.text.defaultMessage: The MCP view's Catalogue lists servers you can install, Combwork's own first. Each download is checked against its catalogue and shows what it runs; updates are offered, never automatic. Add a company's catalogue in Settings → MCP Catalogues.
tips.mcpCatalogue.text.description: A tip (HI-545). The MCP view, Catalogue and Settings → MCP Catalogues are names in Combwork: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.mcpCatalogue.title.defaultMessage: Install a server from a catalogue
tips.mcpCatalogue.title.description: A tip's title (HI-545): the MCP view's Catalogue.

tips.mcpFromFile.textAdded.defaultMessage: Got a server as a .json definition or a .zip of its folder? Add MCP Server from File in the MCP view shows what it runs and adds it to the workspace: then add it to the projects that need it, with Add to… or in their MCP tab.
tips.mcpFromFile.textAdded.description: A tip (HI-2059). Add MCP Server from File, the MCP view, Add to… and the MCP tab are names in Combwork: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.mcpFromFile.title.defaultMessage: Add an MCP server from a file

tips.mcpPerAgent.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's settings, MCP servers: Only these gives it just the servers it needs, such as a sandbox server for a release tester, and keeps the others' tools out of its context.
tips.mcpPerAgent.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.mcpPerAgent.title.defaultMessage: MCP servers for some agents only

tips.mcpPerProject.textAdded.defaultMessage: A workspace MCP server runs only where it is added: Add Server… in a project's MCP tab picks one, showing what it runs. Its tools stay out of the other projects' agents' context, and the tab lists only what that project uses.
tips.mcpPerProject.textAdded.description: A tip (HI-2059). The MCP tab and Add Server… are names in Combwork: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.mcpPerProject.title.defaultMessage: MCP servers only where they are needed

tips.mcpSearch.text.defaultMessage: The MCP view and Add Server… search your servers by name, description and tags (a definition's "tags" list), and show those added somewhere or nowhere.
tips.mcpSearch.text.description: A tip (HI-2059). The MCP view and Add Server… are names in Combwork: keep them as Combwork shows them; "tags" is a field of a server’s JSON definition: keep it.

tips.mcpSearch.title.defaultMessage: Find a server in a long list
tips.mcpSearch.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2059): searching the workspace's MCP servers.

tips.memorySnapshot.text.defaultMessage: Turn on Settings → Advanced → Save a memory snapshot if Combwork is about to run out of memory, to find out what filled it. Snapshots can be gigabytes, hold what Combwork had in memory (card text, transcripts, possibly tokens) and stay on this PC.
tips.memorySnapshot.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.memorySnapshot.title.defaultMessage: Combwork closed running out of memory?

tips.mergeBranch.text.defaultMessage: ⑂ beside a branch in Version Control → Branches & remotes merges it into the branch you pick, one merge at a time. A card's branch that isn't Done asks first, and the card is marked merged outside the rules.
tips.mergeBranch.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: outside the rules.

tips.mergeBranch.title.description: A tip's title (#1450): merging any branch outside cards.

tips.mergeMessage.text.defaultMessage: With Combwork merging, Version Control → Workflow sets the merge’s commit message: Combwork’s names the card, the branch’s own keeps card keys out of your history. With Squash, each card then lands as one commit with its builder’s message.
tips.mergeMessage.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Squash is a merge style's name: use the word Combwork shows for it.

tips.mergeMessage.title.defaultMessage: Merges with your own commit messages
