tips.mergeMessage.title.description: A tip's title (G19): the workflow option that sets the message of the commit Combwork's merge queue makes.

tips.mergePush.text.defaultMessage: With Combwork merging, Version Control → Workflow can push the target branch after each merge, never forced. If the remote refuses it, the queue pauses and says why: pull and resume, or turn it off and resume.
tips.mergePush.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: merge queue.

tips.mergePush.title.defaultMessage: Push each merge to your remote
tips.mergePush.title.description: A tip's title (G18): the workflow option that has Combwork's merge queue push the target branch after each merge.

tips.mergeQueueFolder.text.defaultMessage: When the merge queue merges into a branch checked out in a folder (main in the project folder), it updates the folder too, but pauses rather than touch a file you are changing. Settings → Advanced can have it ask you under For you first.
tips.mergeQueueFolder.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. For you is the board's list of what waits for the user.

tips.mergeQueueFolder.title.defaultMessage: Merging into the folder you work in
tips.mergeQueueFolder.title.description: A tip's title: the merge queue merging into a branch (main) that is checked out in the project folder.

tips.mergeQueuePanel.text.defaultMessage: The Progress panel's Merges tab shows each merge queue: the card it is testing and how long its checks usually take, the cards waiting, and a card it returned until you've seen it. Pause queue and Resume queue are there too.
tips.mergeQueuePanel.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary 2.5: merge queue, Pause queue / Resume queue; 2.4: returned.

tips.mergeQueueRecent.text.defaultMessage: Under each merge queue in the Progress panel's Merges tab, Recent merges lists its latest merges, returns and pauses, with why, when and how long each took. Click one to open its card.
tips.mergeQueueRecent.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary 2.5: merge queue; 2.4: returned.

tips.mergeQueueRecent.title.defaultMessage: See what the merge queue did lately

tips.mergeRebase.text.defaultMessage: With Combwork merging, set Merge style to Rebase and fast-forward in Version Control → Workflow: the merge queue rebases each card onto the target, tests exactly that, and moves the target forward to it.
tips.mergeRebase.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands, and the option's value: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: merge queue.

tips.mergeRebase.title.defaultMessage: A linear history, with no merge commits
tips.mergeRebase.title.description: A tip's title (G6): the merge style Rebase and fast-forward.

tips.mergeSlot.text.defaultMessage: When several agents finish at once, each claims the project's merge slot before it merges main in, checks and merges, so nobody's checks have to run twice. Who holds it and who waits shows in the Overview and the Progress panel.
tips.mergeSlot.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.mergeStrict.text.defaultMessage: With Combwork merging, Version Control → Workflow can have work up to date with its target before it merges: the merge queue updates a card in its own folder, never on the builder’s branch, and the review still counts if it’s the same change.
tips.mergeStrict.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: merge queue, builder, review.

tips.mergeStrict.title.defaultMessage: Work up to date before it merges
tips.mergeStrict.title.description: A tip's title: the workflow option that has Combwork's merge queue bring a card's work up to date with its target branch first (G8, strict).

tips.mergesInto.text.defaultMessage: List a branch such as 1.2.0 under Version Control → Workflow → Other branches work can merge into, then pick it as a lane’s Merges into in Start Lane…, or a card’s in its dialog. Its cards are made from it and merge into it through its own queue.
tips.mergesInto.text.description: A tip (HI-2556). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and fields: keep them as Combwork shows them. Keep 1.2.0 as it is.

tips.mergesInto.title.defaultMessage: Work on the next release beside this one
tips.mergesInto.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2556): lanes and cards that merge into another branch than the project's.

tips.messageReceipts.text.defaultMessage: Every message the Assistant leaves an agent has an id and is kept, even across a restart: it is received once the agent reads its inbox, and acked once the agent acted on it. One not acked within {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} shows as overdue (✉) in its pane.
tips.messageReceipts.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. {minutes} is how long before a message shows as overdue (30).

tips.messageReceipts.title.defaultMessage: See where a message got to

tips.modelFallbacks.text.defaultMessage: Combwork asks Claude Code and Codex which models they have and which effort levels each takes. If a CLI can't say, the model, effort and price lists on its Settings page are yours to edit.
tips.modelFallbacks.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.modelFallbacks.title.defaultMessage: New models without a Combwork update

tips.modelSwitched.text.defaultMessage: If an agent ends up on another model than its connection gave it (Codex's offer of a cheaper model near your limit, or /model), its footer marks the model with a warning and Activity says Model changed. Restart the agent to go back.
tips.modelSwitched.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Codex is a product name; /model is its command: keep it. A connection is the account Combwork starts an agent on.

tips.modelSwitched.title.defaultMessage: An agent on another model is marked
tips.modelSwitched.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2609): an agent running another model than Combwork started it with.

tips.modes.text.defaultMessage: Coordinator runs the agents, Planner shapes work, QA triager turns reports into cards, Release manager takes a release through its checklist. Switch mode from the panel at once, keeping the conversation, or write your own.
tips.modes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.moreAgents.text.defaultMessage: Need more than {usual, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} in a project? Raise Maximum agents in Version Control → Workflow, up to {most, number}, then add them. Above {usual, number} it shows what they cost: the memory your running agents take, and how much is free.
tips.moreAgents.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. {usual} is how many agents a project has by default (12), {most} the most it can have (24). Maximum agents is a workflow option (HI-2001).

tips.moreAgents.title.defaultMessage: More than {usual, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}
tips.moreAgents.title.description: A tip's title. {usual} is how many agents a project can have by default (12).

tips.moveAnyway.text.defaultMessage: Dragging a card past a rule of its project (to Done before its review, say) asks first and names the rules it skips. Move Anyway records an override on the card, with your reason: an open lock on its tile says who, which rules and why.
tips.moveAnyway.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: rule, override, Move anyway.

tips.moveAnyway.title.defaultMessage: Move a card past its rules, with a reason

tips.myPrices.text.defaultMessage: Claude Code's cost is its own figure, from its price table. On other rates (a discount, another tier)? Set Session costs to My prices, and Combwork prices every session from your table instead.
tips.myPrices.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.myPrices.title.defaultMessage: Your own prices for Claude Code

tips.newCard.text.defaultMessage: Press {key} for a new card for the project you are in, without leaving what you are doing.
tips.newCard.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.noCodeCards.text.defaultMessage: A decision, a write-up or a trial has nothing to commit: tick No code in the New Card dialog. Its work is submitted with a summary and goes to Done with nothing to merge.
tips.noCodeCards.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: no-code card.

tips.off.message.defaultMessage: Help → Tips… still has them, and Settings → General turns them back on.
tips.off.message.description: More in the notice after the tips were turned off. Help → Tips… and Settings → General are names in Combwork: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.off.title.description: A notice after "Don't show tips" on the tip card.

tips.oneAgent.text.defaultMessage: The ▾ beside Resume (n) and Stop (n) in the project header lists those agents: choose one to act on it alone. Agents ▾ and a project's right-click menu have the same for Start New, Archive and Start New, Resume All and Stop All.
tips.oneAgent.text.description: A tip (HI-2665). ▾ is the narrow arrow button beside the project header's Resume (n) and Stop (n): keep it. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.oneAgent.title.defaultMessage: Resume or stop just one agent

tips.opencode.text.defaultMessage: Agents can use OpenCode 2. Provider Setup installs it; each OpenCode account keeps its own provider sign-ins and sessions, and each agent runs a private OpenCode server that ends with it.
tips.opencode.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. OpenCode is a product name.

tips.opencode.title.description: A tip's title. OpenCode is a product name.

tips.opencodeHistory.text.defaultMessage: An OpenCode agent's conversation shows in the Sessions tab, and its tokens and cost in the Overview and its pane's footer, as OpenCode reports them. A $0 cost isn't a measure of your plan's allowance; limits show only for OpenCode Go or Console.
tips.opencodeHistory.text.description: A tip (HI-2762). Names of Combwork's views: keep them as Combwork shows them. OpenCode, OpenCode Go and Console are product names. $0 is an amount: keep it.

tips.opencodeHistory.title.defaultMessage: An OpenCode agent's history, tokens and cost
tips.opencodeHistory.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2762). OpenCode is a product name.

tips.opencodeOwnProvider.text.defaultMessage: An OpenCode agent uses only the provider in its connection's model, so nothing it does goes to another provider or to OpenCode's free cloud models. Name the connection's model, such as ollama/qwen3:8b; Settings → Advanced → OpenCode turns this off.
tips.opencodeOwnProvider.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views and settings: keep them as Combwork shows them. OpenCode is a product name; ollama/qwen3:8b is a model id: keep it.

tips.opencodeOwnProvider.title.defaultMessage: OpenCode keeps to the connection's provider
tips.opencodeOwnProvider.title.description: A tip's title. OpenCode is a product name.

tips.outageResume.text.defaultMessage: Turn on Settings → Advanced → Resume agents after a connection drops, and an agent stopped by a router restart or a Wi-Fi blip waits for the connection, then reruns what was cut off by itself. Never for a usage limit or an expired sign-in.
tips.outageResume.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.outageResume.title.defaultMessage: Agents can carry on after a connection drops

tips.overview.text.defaultMessage: The Workspace Overview shows what every project used, what runs now and the board, by day. {key}
tips.overview.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.overview.title.defaultMessage: The whole workspace at a glance

tips.ownShortcuts.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts changes any shortcut, and Project Settings can change them for one project.
tips.ownShortcuts.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.palette.text.defaultMessage: Press {key} and type: every command, with its shortcut.
tips.palette.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.palette.title.defaultMessage: Everything is in the command palette

tips.paneCells.text.defaultMessage: Drag a pane by its header onto an empty pane to move it there, or onto another to swap them. Each layout keeps where you put them, so switching layouts and back restores it.
tips.paneCells.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.paneCells.title.defaultMessage: Put an agent in any pane

tips.pasteScreenshot.text.defaultMessage: Press Ctrl+V in an agent's terminal with an image on the clipboard, or drop an image onto it: the agent sees it, and Combwork keeps a copy.
tips.pasteScreenshot.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.pasteScreenshot.title.defaultMessage: Paste a screenshot into a session

tips.pathsLeftOut.text.defaultMessage: Without version control, a card's work is only the files its paths list. When you drag one to Review and other files changed since it started, Combwork lists them first: include them in its work, or leave them out.
tips.pathsLeftOut.text.description: A tip. A card's paths: the files and folders its work covers, in a project with no version control. Review is the board column.

tips.pathsLeftOut.title.defaultMessage: No version control? Check what a card covers
tips.pathsLeftOut.title.description: A tip's title: in a project without version control, a card's work is the files its paths list.

tips.pauseTeam.text.defaultMessage: Pause the Team, in the Progress panel's Lanes, stops lanes starting cards and agents being woken, tells each agent to park, and lists what still runs until it's safe to install: then Install Now.
tips.pauseTeam.text.description: A tip (HI-2081). Pause the Team, the Progress panel, Lanes and Install Now are names in Combwork: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.pauseTeam.title.defaultMessage: Pause the team before an update
tips.pauseTeam.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2081). 'The team' is every agent of the workspace.

tips.perfCompare.text.defaultMessage: Performance → Compare: keep the current view before a change and again after it, and see whether Combwork’s traffic fell while the work still got done.
tips.perfCompare.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.perfCompareAgents.text.defaultMessage: Comparing two scenario benchmarks? Open a scenario in Performance → Compare: its measures show the session under test first, then the other agents (a lane’s builder and reviewer) and all of them together, with each agent’s Combwork tool calls.
tips.perfCompareAgents.text.description: A tip (HI-2186). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Keep Combwork (the app's name). Glossary: builder, reviewer.

tips.perfCompareAgents.title.defaultMessage: Which agent a change came from

tips.perfFailures.text.defaultMessage: Performance → Failures sorts what didn’t succeed: real errors in red, apart from calls a workflow rule refused and wrong calls. Refusals and wrong calls by reason shows which rule or message came up most: a tool description to make clearer.
tips.perfFailures.text.description: A tip (HI-2553). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Failures is a card, Refusals and wrong calls by reason a table of the Performance view).

tips.perfFailures.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2553): a request refused by a workflow rule isn't a fault.

tips.performance.text.defaultMessage: Performance, in the activity bar, shows what Combwork's API, tools and guidance cost for the last day, week or month: the whole workspace or one project. Each project has its own Performance tab too.
tips.performance.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.permissionMode.text.defaultMessage: Click the mode in an agent's footer, or press {key}, to move between asking first, accepting edits and planning.
tips.permissionMode.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.planLimitsProviders.text.defaultMessage: The status bar shows how much of your plan is used for Antigravity and Copilot too: Antigravity's weekly quotas for Gemini and for other models, Copilot's monthly premium requests and chats. Hover it for when each resets.
tips.planLimitsProviders.text.description: A tip (HI-2734). Antigravity and Copilot are products' names; Gemini is Google's models' name.

tips.planLimitsProviders.title.defaultMessage: Every plan's limits in the status bar

tips.progressCard.text.defaultMessage: A run in the Progress panel shows the card and the revision it ran on under the agent, such as #1061 · a3f2c1d: click the card to open it, or the revision to copy it.
tips.progressCard.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. #1061 is a card's number and a3f2c1d a commit's short id: keep them as they are.

tips.progressCard.title.defaultMessage: Which card was that run for?

tips.progressCheck.text.defaultMessage: A run for a card is recorded as a check of the card's revision. Its details in the Progress panel say Counts as check, or why not: it wasn't started as the check, the folder had uncommitted changes, or files changed while it ran.
tips.progressCheck.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. "Counts as check" is how a run's details say it counts: keep it as the details do.

tips.progressCheck.title.defaultMessage: Did that run count as a check?

tips.progressCommand.text.defaultMessage: Agents run long commands such as tests and builds through cw-progress, so the Progress panel shows them under the agent's name, with about how long is left from the second time. Settings can have them do it only when you ask.
tips.progressCommand.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.progressDetails.text.defaultMessage: Click a run in the Progress panel, or one under Recent, for its details: the whole command, when it ran and how long it took, its exit code, the log it wrote and why it failed.
tips.progressDetails.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.progressFilter.text.defaultMessage: When several projects run tests and builds, the dropdown at the top of the Progress panel shows just one project's runs, or one agent's. Each workspace remembers the choice.
tips.progressFilter.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.progressHistory.text.defaultMessage: The Runs tab of the Progress panel keeps the last {kept, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}, even after Combwork restarts: by day, a run and its retries in one line. Find them by their words, or show only failures, a lane’s or an agent’s.
tips.progressHistory.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Runs: the Progress panel's tab of runs). {kept} is how many runs Combwork keeps (200).

tips.progressLanes.text.defaultMessage: When pairs of agents work through cards, the bottom of the Progress panel shows each lane as a bar, a segment per card coloured by where it is. Hover one for its card and round; click to open it. A merge going on shows as a teal card at the top.
tips.progressLanes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.progressLanes.title.defaultMessage: How far along is each pair?

tips.progressLanesHeight.text.defaultMessage: The Progress panel shows up to four lanes. Drag the line above Lanes up to see more, a whole lane at a time; double-click it to go back to four. Each workspace remembers it.
tips.progressLanesHeight.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.progressLanesOrder.text.defaultMessage: Drag a running lane up or down in the Progress panel, or focus it and press Alt+Up or Alt+Down. Each workspace keeps your order; a new lane comes in on top, and merged ones drop to the bottom.
tips.progressLanesOrder.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.progressPanel.text.defaultMessage: When agents run tests or builds that report progress, the Progress panel on the right shows each run: the agent, how far along it is and the time left, and Combwork's taskbar button fills as they go. {key} shows it.
tips.progressPanel.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.progressPanel.title.defaultMessage: How long until the tests finish?

tips.progressTabs.text.defaultMessage: The Progress panel has four tabs: Pulse for what is going on now, then Merges, Runs and Lanes. A red number on Runs counts the runs that failed with nothing passing since; Pulse has a line for them too.
tips.progressTabs.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (the tabs: Pulse, Merges, Runs, Lanes).

tips.progressTabs.title.description: A tip's title: the Progress panel's tabs, named as the panel shows them.

tips.projectCards.text.defaultMessage: A project's Overview starts with its cards: how many are in each column, stalled or blocked. Click a number to open its Tasks tab.
tips.projectCards.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.projectCards.title.defaultMessage: A project's cards at a glance

tips.projectKeys.text.defaultMessage: Each project has a key of 2 to 4 letters that names its cards: AM-12. Search the board or the command palette for AM-12, or AM- for all of that project’s cards; an old #12 still works. Change a key in Project Settings.
tips.projectKeys.text.description: A tip. AM-12 and AM- are examples of a card's name and a project's key: keep them as they are. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands (Project Settings): keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.projectKeys.title.defaultMessage: Cards are named by their project’s key
tips.projectKeys.title.description: A tip's title. A key is 2–4 letters, such as AM, that a project's cards are named by (AM-12).

tips.projectTabs.text.defaultMessage: When space is short, a project's tabs shrink to icons, and the tab you're on keeps its name while it fits. Hover a tab for its name and shortcut.
tips.projectTabs.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.projectTabsKeys.text.defaultMessage: Alt+1 to Alt+8 open a project's tabs in the order they show, Session to Git. Memory, Skills, Templates and MCP are in More ▾ at the end, and in the menu bar's Project menu.
tips.projectTabsKeys.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. More ▾ is the button's name with its arrow.

tips.projectTabsKeys.title.defaultMessage: Alt and a number for each tab

tips.projectTabsSettings.text.defaultMessage: The last item of More ▾, at the end of a project's tabs, is Project Settings…, with its shortcut (Alt+0 unless you change it).
tips.projectTabsSettings.text.description: A tip (HI-1840). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. More ▾ is the button's name with its arrow; Project Settings… is the menu item's name, with its ….

tips.projectTabsSettings.title.description: A tip's title (HI-1840). More ▾ is the button's name with its arrow.

tips.quitWhenDone.text.defaultMessage: Quitting while an agent works offers Quit when agents finish: Combwork hides and quits by itself once they're done. Conversations are always kept.
tips.quitWhenDone.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.recentWorkspaces.text.defaultMessage: Remove a workspace from File → Open Recent or the welcome page with its ✕, or right-click it. Clear Recently Opened forgets them all; folders that are gone show as not found.
tips.recentWorkspaces.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.removeAll.text.defaultMessage: Remove All in the project header removes all of a project's agents after one question. Worktrees are kept unless you tick the box, which deletes only merged, clean ones.
tips.removeAll.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.resumeAfterUpdate.text.defaultMessage: Installing a new version tells the agents that were working or in a card loop, and when Combwork restarts it resumes them in their conversations, one at a time, each told its card, round and lane. After you quit, the next start offers to resume them instead.
tips.resumeAfterUpdate.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.resumeAfterUpdate.title.defaultMessage: Updates leave your agents where they were

tips.resumeAll.text.defaultMessage: After a restart, Resume All Agents in the project header resumes every stopped agent's last session in one go.
tips.resumeAll.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.retargetRelease.text.defaultMessage: Changing Work merges into from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0? Save… lists the Todo cards and free slots still on 1.1.0 that can follow 1.2.0, and what stays, with why. Leave Also retarget what can move ticked to move them.
tips.retargetRelease.text.description: A tip (HI-2680). Work merges into, Save… and Also retarget what can move are names in Combwork's window: keep them as Combwork shows them. Keep 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 as they are.

tips.retargetRelease.title.defaultMessage: When a release ships, move what’s left onto the next
tips.retargetRelease.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2680): after a project's Work merges into moves on to the next release's branch.

tips.retryWait.text.defaultMessage: When a Codex, Claude Code or Copilot agent's requests are refused, often by a rate limit, it waits and tries again while its screen says only Working. Combwork reads the wait from the agent's own records, and its status says so.
tips.retryWait.text.description: A tip (HI-1972, HI-1973). Codex, Claude Code and Copilot are product names; Working is what their screens show.

tips.retryWait.title.defaultMessage: See when an agent is rate-limited
tips.retryWait.title.description: A tip's title (HI-1972, HI-1973): when an agent's coding agent has its model requests refused as too many.

tips.reviewCopies.text.defaultMessage: A reviewer reviews in a review copy: a folder at exactly the submitted revision, which nothing else writes, so the builder can carry on meanwhile. Its checks there count for that submission. Settings → Advanced turns it off.
tips.reviewCopies.text.description: A tip. A review copy: a folder Combwork keeps at exactly the revision under review. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.reviewCopies.title.defaultMessage: Reviewers test exactly what was submitted

tips.reviewSkip.text.defaultMessage: Building an installer or a quick trial needs no reviewer? Tick Skip review in the New Card dialog: submitting the card finishes it, and a code card still goes on to its merge, with its merge checks.
tips.reviewSkip.text.description: A tip (#1625). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Skip review is the New Card dialog's tick box).

tips.reviewSkip.title.defaultMessage: Cards that don't need a review
tips.reviewSkip.title.description: A tip's title (#1625): a card can skip its review.

tips.reviewerPool.text.defaultMessage: With the workflow option Reviewers set to A shared pool, Start Lane offers the reviewer pool: each card submitted goes to the next free reviewer, oldest first, never to its own builder.
tips.reviewerPool.text.description: A tip. Reviewers and A shared pool are a workflow option and its value; Start Lane is a dialog: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: reviewer pool, builder.

tips.reviewerPool.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Combwork's record of a card loop (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.safeguardStops.text.defaultMessage: A shield beside an agent's status means its CLI's safety classifier stopped a response: hover it for when, the model, and the agent's last tool calls before it. Orange means its model changed since, or it waits on you.
tips.safeguardStops.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.safeguardStops.title.defaultMessage: See when a safety classifier stops an agent

tips.saveTemplate.text.defaultMessage: Set agents up once and reuse them: + Add ▾ → Templates → Save Template… in the session toolbar keeps their settings, roles and layout, and the same menu loads them into any project.
tips.saveTemplate.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.saveTemplate.title.defaultMessage: Save your agents as a template

tips.searchClear.text.defaultMessage: Every search and filter box has an × while it has text: click it, or press Escape, to see everything again. In a dialog or the palette, the next Escape closes it.
tips.searchClear.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.searchClear.title.defaultMessage: Clear a search in one go

tips.searchTranscripts.text.defaultMessage: The Sessions tab searches every session's name, date and transcript (Ctrl+F there): the tree keeps what matches, and a hit opens the conversation at that message.
tips.searchTranscripts.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.serverDiagnostics.text.defaultMessage: Check Server… on a server account in Settings → Accounts & Connections shows its model's real context and tests a tool call. A context smaller than Claude Code's prompt is the usual reason a local model prints a tool call instead of making it.
tips.serverDiagnostics.text.description: A tip (HI-2683). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Check Server… is a button).

tips.serverDiagnostics.title.defaultMessage: An agent on Ollama just prints text?
tips.serverDiagnostics.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2683): an agent on a local model server writes its tool calls out as text instead of making them. Ollama is a product's name.

tips.sessionCleanup.text.defaultMessage: The Sessions tab's Clean Up Old Sessions… button archives or deletes every session last active more than {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, {week, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} or {month, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago. Running sessions and the one you're reading are left alone.
tips.sessionCleanup.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. {hours}, {week} and {month} are its choices of age (24 hours, 7 days and 30 days).

tips.sessionSizes.text.defaultMessage: The Sessions tab shows each session's transcript size. One in amber is past Warn when a transcript is over: hand its work over to a new conversation to keep things quick.
tips.sessionSizes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.sessionSizes.title.defaultMessage: Spot the conversations that grew too long

tips.sessionToolbar.text.defaultMessage: The chip above the panes counts your agents by state; its ▾ lists them, most urgent first: choose one to go to it. Panes | Tiles beside it switches between the agents' terminals and a small tile each.
tips.sessionToolbar.text.description: A tip. Panes and Tiles: the toggle's words, as Combwork shows them.

tips.sessionToolbar.title.defaultMessage: Jump to any agent, or see them all as tiles

tips.sessionTree.text.defaultMessage: In the Sessions tab, right-click a provider, an agent or a session with sub-sessions to archive or delete everything in it at once. Running sessions and ones in use are skipped, and Combwork says which.
tips.sessionTree.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.sessionTree.title.defaultMessage: Clear out a whole branch of sessions

tips.shareTemplates.text.defaultMessage: The Templates view (activity bar) and a project's Templates tab list every template. Export… saves one as a file for teammates; Import… brings one in, for the workspace or a project.
tips.shareTemplates.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.sharedNotes.text.defaultMessage: Shared notes and handovers live in the workspace, so every project's agents can read them with Combwork's tools.
tips.sharedNotes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.signInExpired.text.defaultMessage: If Claude Code's or Codex's sign-in expires, its agents show Needs sign-in (a violet dot) and you're told once. Sign in again, then Resume All Agents in the project header carries on the ones that stopped.
tips.signInExpired.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.silentUnknown.text.defaultMessage: Combwork never guesses an agent is idle: when its turn has been silent for a while with no sign of its end, its pane says so. If its terminal waits at its prompt, Mark idle puts it right.
tips.silentUnknown.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.silentUnknown.title.defaultMessage: An agent silent with its state unknown

tips.skillFiles.text.defaultMessage: Agents read a skill's SKILL.md whenever they use it, and a file it links only when they need that part. A skill's page shows each of its files in a tab, to read and edit; a link to one opens its tab.
tips.skillFiles.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. SKILL.md is a file name: keep it in English.

tips.skillFiles.title.defaultMessage: A skill can link files beside its SKILL.md
tips.skillFiles.title.description: A tip's title. SKILL.md is a file name: keep it in English.

tips.skillsDelivered.text.defaultMessage: The switch beside each Combwork skill, in the Skills view or a project's Skills tab, says whether agents get it (Delivered to agents). Copies Combwork puts in a folder for Codex and Copilot are removed once no agent works there, as Settings → Advanced says.
tips.skillsDelivered.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Codex and Copilot are CLIs' names.

tips.slotHeld.text.defaultMessage: When Combwork can't tell that everything an agent's session started in a slot has ended, it keeps the slot for it rather than guess. Release Slot… in the agent's ⋯ menu shows what Combwork knows, ends what it lists if you want, and frees the slot.
tips.slotHeld.text.description: A tip. A slot: a folder Combwork lends to a card or a lane. Release Slot… is a menu item: keep it as Combwork shows it; ⋯ is the agent's menu button.

tips.slotHeld.title.defaultMessage: Free a slot held after Combwork closed
tips.slotHeld.title.description: A tip's title (#1506). A slot: a folder Combwork lends to a card or a lane.

tips.slotOptions.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Workflow → Slots and copies holds the script run in a new slot, the files copied into it and the slots in use, and how many review copies the project keeps. They save as you change them.
tips.slotOptions.text.description: A tip. A slot: a folder Combwork lends to a card or a lane; a review copy: a folder at exactly the revision a reviewer reviews. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.slotOptions.title.defaultMessage: Set up slots in Version Control
tips.slotOptions.title.description: A tip's title. A slot: a folder Combwork lends to a card or a lane.

tips.slotResume.text.defaultMessage: A builder's conversation stays in its card's slot. Once the card ends, Resume All leaves it so the slot stays free for new work; its own Resume takes the slot back while nothing else has used it.
tips.slotResume.text.description: A tip. A slot is a worktree Combwork lends to a card. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.slotResume.title.defaultMessage: A conversation resumes where it was made

tips.slots.text.defaultMessage: With Where cards are built set to Each card in its own folder, starting a card lends its builder a slot, a ready worktree, and makes the card's branch there. A lane keeps its slot from card to card; with every slot in use, it waits for one.
tips.slots.text.description: A tip. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Combwork lends to a card or a lane. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands (Where cards are built is a workflow option, Each card in its own folder its value; glossary 2.6, G11): keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.slots.title.defaultMessage: Each card on a branch of its own
tips.slots.title.description: A tip's title. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Combwork lends to a card or a lane.

tips.slotsAdopted.text.defaultMessage: Since the upgrade, each builder's own worktree is a slot kept for it until its next card or lane takes it over. Release Slot… in the agent's ⋯ menu gives one up; once free, Combwork renames its folder to a slot name, taking its conversations with it.
tips.slotsAdopted.text.description: A tip. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Combwork lends to a card or a lane. Release Slot… is a menu item: keep it as Combwork shows it; ⋯ is the agent's menu button.

tips.slotsAdopted.title.defaultMessage: Your agents' worktrees are slots now
tips.slotsAdopted.title.description: A tip's title, after upgrading from version 0.9. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Combwork lends to a card or a lane.

tips.sortTables.text.defaultMessage: Click a column's header in Combwork's tables (shortcuts, Performance, Storage, the Overviews) to sort by it, again for the other way. Combwork remembers each table's sort and rows per page.
tips.sortTables.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.staleMessages.text.defaultMessage: When the Assistant relays something about a card's current round, it ties the message to that card: if the card passes or starts another round before the agent reads it, Combwork drops it as stale, so no agent reopens a passed card for an old finding.
tips.staleMessages.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.staleMessages.title.defaultMessage: A message about a round goes stale, not late

tips.startFreshIdle.text.defaultMessage: Long conversations cost more. Start Fresh (Idle Agents) in the project header's Agents menu gives every idle agent a new one in one step, and Combwork suggests it when a project's work has finished.
tips.startFreshIdle.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.startFreshIdle.title.defaultMessage: Start idle agents fresh when work is done

tips.startNewAll.text.defaultMessage: Start New in the project header's Agents menu gives every agent a new session after one question; Archive and Start New archives their old ones first. Their conversations stay in the Sessions tab.
tips.startNewAll.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.stoppedPane.text.defaultMessage: When an agent's session ends, its pane is dimmed and its bar says when and why (stopped by you, its lane ended, its CLI exited…). Its last output stays readable, and Resume or New Session there starts it again.
tips.stoppedPane.text.description: A tip (HI-1881). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.storageCleanup.text.defaultMessage: Project Settings → Storage shows how much space a project's backups, archive, attachments and worktrees take. Clean Up… moves old attachments and backups to the Recycle Bin, and shows you exactly what goes first.
tips.storageCleanup.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.storageCleanup.title.defaultMessage: See what Combwork keeps, and clean up

tips.storagePurge.text.defaultMessage: Purge… in Project Settings → Storage, or Purge Combwork's Files… on a session, removes everything Combwork keeps for sessions: backups, attachments and leftovers. It lists every file first; the coding agents' own files and your usage totals stay.
tips.storagePurge.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.taskbarBadge.text.defaultMessage: Combwork's taskbar button shows how many agents need you, and flashes when one asks you something while Combwork is in the background.
tips.taskbarBadge.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.teamPreset.text.defaultMessage: Team, in Version Control → Workflow, is Pair with stricter checks: the unit tests pass before review and on the merged result, dependencies are installed from scratch before every merge, and cards labelled ui or release wait for your OK.
tips.teamPreset.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (glossary 2.1: Team, Pair).

tips.teamPreset.title.defaultMessage: Several builders? Try the Team preset

tips.teamTemplates.text.defaultMessage: The Templates view’s Combwork group has ready-made teams: Solo, Pair, Pair: one provider, Team 3×3, Team 6×6 and Team 6 + pool, with builders and reviewers paired. Loading one offers to switch the project to the preset it suits.
tips.teamTemplates.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands, and of Combwork's own templates: keep them as Combwork shows them. Glossary: builder, reviewer, preset.

tips.teamTemplates.title.defaultMessage: Start from one of Combwork’s templates

tips.templateNames.text.defaultMessage: Agent names are unique across the workspace. Loading a template from another project, give its agents new names in the list beside the template's own: Load template waits until none is taken.
tips.templateNames.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.templateNames.title.defaultMessage: Name a template's agents as you load it

tips.templateWorkflow.text.defaultMessage: Save Template… can keep the project's workflow too: its rules, never its branch or commands. Loading it shows what changes, then opens Version Control → Workflow filled in, to save there.
tips.templateWorkflow.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.templateWorkflow.title.defaultMessage: Keep your workflow in a template

tips.testedClis.text.defaultMessage: Claude Code, Codex and Copilot update on their own. Provider Setup shows the version this Combwork release was tested with next to the one you have, and says when yours is newer or older.
tips.testedClis.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.testedClis.title.defaultMessage: See which CLI versions Combwork was tested with

tips.tileStrip.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's focus view (Tiles), the strip on the left shows each agent's card as a small chip, tinted with the colour of the board column it is in; click one to open the card. Drag the strip's edge to make it wider, and double-click the edge to reset it.
tips.tileStrip.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands (Tiles): keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.tileStrip.title.defaultMessage: Each agent's card, beside its name

tips.tileStripOrder.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's focus view (Tiles), drag an agent up or down the strip on the left, or press Alt+Up or Alt+Down on it. The tiles and the panes follow the same order.
tips.tileStripOrder.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands (Tiles): keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.tileStripOrder.title.defaultMessage: Reorder agents from the focus view

tips.tilesView.text.defaultMessage: Tiles shows each agent as a small tile: its state, status, card, progress and latest reply, twelve to a page. Click one to open its pane large beside the others; Esc goes back. Settings → Sessions → Tile order can put the agents waiting for you first.
tips.tilesView.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands (Tiles, Tile order): keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.tilesView.title.defaultMessage: See a whole team at once as tiles

tips.triageReport.text.defaultMessage: Tell the Assistant in QA triager mode what you did and saw, or paste a screenshot. It finds the cause in the code, checks for a card that already covers it (even one not merged yet), then files a card with the evidence.
tips.triageReport.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.triageReport.title.defaultMessage: Report a problem to the QA triager
tips.triageReport.title.description: A tip's title. QA triager is a mode of the Combwork Assistant: keep its name as Combwork shows it.

tips.twoProviders.text.defaultMessage: Agents in one project can use different providers: say a Codex reviewer next to a Claude Code agent. Hand Over to… passes work between them.
tips.twoProviders.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.ui.close.description: Closes the tip card or Help → Tips.

tips.ui.counter.defaultMessage: {total, plural, one {Tip · {n, number} of #} other {Tip · {n, number} of #}}
tips.ui.counter.description: The tip card's heading: which tip ({n}) of how many ({total}) it is. A plural on {total}, for a language whose words change with it.

tips.ui.learnMore.description: Button on a tip: opens the user guide where it explains it.

tips.ui.next.description: Button on the tip card: shows the next tip.

tips.ui.noMatch.description: Help → Tips when its search finds nothing. {query} is what was typed; use your language's quotation marks.

tips.ui.off.description: A link on the tip card: turns off the tip when Combwork starts.

tips.ui.search.description: Placeholder of Help → Tips' search box.

tips.ui.showOnStart.defaultMessage: Show a tip when Combwork starts
tips.ui.showOnStart.description: A switch in Help → Tips: shows a tip of the day when Combwork starts (the same as Settings → General → Show a tip when Combwork starts).

tips.ui.tip.description: The name, for screen readers, of the tip card.

tips.ui.tryIt.description: Button on a tip: runs the command it is about.

tips.unexpectedClose.text.defaultMessage: If Combwork was ended without quitting (a crash, or something closed it), the next start says when it was last seen and which agents were running, with Resume All. Settings → Sessions → Resume agents after an unexpected close resumes them by itself.
tips.unexpectedClose.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.unmerged.text.defaultMessage: The agent's tab shows how many commits aren't merged yet, Merge… in its ⋯ menu says what is left, and Version Control → Changes shows everything the agent changed since it branched.
tips.unmerged.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.unmerged.title.defaultMessage: See what a worktree agent has to merge

tips.unusedWorktrees.text.defaultMessage: Removed an agent but kept its worktree? Version Control → Changes opens on the worktrees no agent uses, saying who made each: open one to see its work and merge it, or remove the merged ones with their branches.
tips.unusedWorktrees.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.updateFromTarget.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Branches & remotes: a branch behind the target has Update. Merge the target in or rebase onto it, where the branch is checked out; a conflict is undone at once, naming its files.
tips.updateFromTarget.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.updateFromTarget.title.defaultMessage: Bring a branch up to date with its target

tips.usageMoves.text.defaultMessage: In Settings → Accounts & Connections, open an account’s ⋯ → Account Settings… and tick When it reaches 98% of its weekly limit, move its agents to another account: they move once their turn is over and carry on there.
tips.usageMoves.text.description: A tip (HI-2195). Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them; the rule is quoted as the setting shows it.

tips.usageMoves.title.defaultMessage: Move agents before a plan runs out
tips.usageMoves.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2195): an account's agents move to another account when its plan's usage reaches a share.

tips.versionControlSwitch.text.defaultMessage: Click None or Git atop a project’s Version Control tab to switch it from its next card; cards in flight keep the old rules. Each keeps its own workflow options, and when the folder changes (git init, say), Combwork offers the switch there.
tips.versionControlSwitch.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (glossary 2.1: None, Git, Version Control, old rules, workflow). Keep git init as it is (a command).

tips.versionControlTab.text.defaultMessage: A project’s Version Control tab says what Combwork found in its folder, and starts with Workflow: who reviews, which checks pass first and who merges. Its header names the preset, and a click on it opens them.
tips.versionControlTab.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (glossary 2.1: Version Control, Workflow, preset).

tips.versionControlTab.title.defaultMessage: One tab for version control and workflow
tips.versionControlTab.title.description: A tip's title (glossary 2.1: version control, workflow).

tips.viewerTokens.text.defaultMessage: An app that shows what your agents are doing, such as Apiary, needs only a viewer token: Settings → Agent API → Viewer tokens makes one that can read everything and change nothing, and revokes it again.
tips.viewerTokens.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.waitingOnPurpose.text.defaultMessage: A card in Active held for a quiet window, or waiting for an answer? Right-click it, Mark as Waiting…, and say why: Combwork stops reporting it as stalled until you clear it or it leaves Active. Its agent keeps running.
tips.waitingOnPurpose.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (Mark as Waiting… is a card's menu item, Active a board stage).

tips.waitingOnPurpose.title.defaultMessage: A card that waits on purpose
tips.waitingOnPurpose.title.description: A tip's title (HI-2618): a card in Active marked as waiting on purpose, so it isn't reported as stalled.

tips.workflowDefaults.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Version Control sets the options every project starts from: Combwork defaults, for every workspace, and the open workspace’s over them. A project’s own options still win, and saving lists the projects that inherit the change.
tips.workflowDefaults.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (glossary 2.1: workflow).

tips.workflowDefaults.title.defaultMessage: Set a workflow once for every project

tips.workflowOptions.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Workflow sets who reviews a card’s work, which checks pass first and who merges it. Pick a preset, or set each option: a change applies from the next card that starts.
tips.workflowOptions.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.workflowOptions.title.defaultMessage: Choose how cards get to Done

tips.workflowPresetsWhy.text.defaultMessage: In Version Control → Workflow, click Solo, Pair or Team: it lists each option it sets and why, and marks what it would change. Nothing changes until you use it and save.
tips.workflowPresetsWhy.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them (glossary 2.1: Solo, Pair, Team).

tips.workflowPresetsWhy.title.defaultMessage: See what a preset does before you use it

tips.workspaceMoved.text.defaultMessage: Moved the workspace folder, say to another drive? Open it from its new place and choose Repair… in the banner: agents' worktrees, their sessions, and Claude Code's conversations and memory follow it.
tips.workspaceMoved.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.workspaceMoved.title.defaultMessage: Move a workspace without losing its agents

tips.workspaceMovedDefender.text.defaultMessage: If Combwork had Defender skip the workspace's folders, Repair… after a move offers to move those exclusions to the new folders, with one administrator prompt, so none is left on a folder that's gone. Exclusions you made yourself stay as they are.
tips.workspaceMovedDefender.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them.

tips.workspaceMovedDefender.title.defaultMessage: Defender exclusions follow a moved workspace

tips.workspaceNotes.text.defaultMessage: Workspace notes, pinned first in Shared Notes, is for what's true of this machine, like a full path. Every agent gets it when it starts, in any folder, so it needn't go in a committed AGENTS.md. A section headed with a project's name is that project's alone.
tips.workspaceNotes.text.description: A tip. Names of Combwork's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Combwork shows them. Workspace notes is a shared note's name and AGENTS.md a file name: keep both in English.

tips.workspaceNotes.title.defaultMessage: Notes about this machine for every agent
